definitions: A barrier built to prevent flooding from the sea or a river.
A wall made of stone or earth, especially in Scotland.
An intrusive body of igneous rock that cuts across the layers of surrounding rock.
A slang term for a lesbian, often used disparagingly but also reclaimed.
examples: The sea dyke protected the lowlands.
A dry-stone dyke ran along the field.
The volcanic dyke was visible in the cliff face.
